This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice P Sree Sudha
 Oral Judgment
Learned counsel for the respondent No.2 is present.
Learned counsel for the appellant is absent.
In proceeding sheet dated 29.01.2024, it was mentioned that, as per order dated 18.12.2023, Court notice issued to the appellant has returned with an endorsement as "deceased".
Till today, steps were not taken to bring the legal representatives of the deceased appellant on record.
Hence, appeal stands dismissed as abated.
